name: pubexam
description: 考公题目梳理 Agent — 全栈智能题库系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && cd server && npx prisma generate && cd ../client && npm install && npx vite build
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed && node src/index.js
